title: IPhO
text: The International Physics Olympiad (IPhO) is an annual international competition for high school students that brings together the most talented young physicists from around the world. Each participating country selects a small team—usually five students—through a rigorous national selection process, and the competition consists of both challenging theoretical exams and complex experimental laboratory problems. The theoretical portion tests deep understanding of advanced topics such as mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, and modern physics, often at a level beyond typical high school curricula, while the experimental portion requires careful data analysis, precision measurement, and strong problem-solving skills. Beyond the exams, the IPhO also promotes cultural exchange and international collaboration, as students meet peers from dozens of countries and share a passion for physics. It is widely regarded as one of the most prestigious science competitions for secondary school students worldwide.
